parameters.content:
## AI GitHub Code Review System

Webhook-triggered orchestrator that reviews a GitHub commit/PR with 9 specialized AI agents.

**Pipeline:** validate → cached repo metadata → fetch commit → filter files → chunk context → fan out to 9 reviewers (reusable sub-workflow) → aggregate → weighted score → summaries → JSON response.

**POST** `/webhook/github-code-review`
Body: `{ organization, repository, branch, commitSha, pullRequestNumber }`

## Extend with new reviewers

Add a new specialized agent by appending ONE entry to the array in **Build Reviewer Configs** (reviewerKey, reviewerName, scored, focus). No other node changes are needed — the reusable sub-workflow handles any reviewer generically.

Add its weight in **Aggregate Findings** if it should affect the overall score.

## GitHub access: REST API (with MCP swap-in)

This workflow uses the **GitHub REST API** via HTTP Request (githubApi credential) because no GitHub MCP server is configured on this instance.

**To use GitHub MCP instead:** replace **Fetch Repo Metadata** / **Fetch Commit** with an MCP Client Tool node (n8n-nodes-mcp) pointed at your GitHub MCP server, keeping the same output fields the downstream Code nodes expect (commit.author, commit.message, files[]).

HTTP nodes retry 3× with backoff to absorb GitHub rate limits.
